Name: BEHAVIOR_PARAM_ST
Description: What an animation's behaviour event does: the attack, bullet or SpEffect it starts, its stamina, poise and other costs, and which buffs apply to it. Players use BehaviorParam_PC (with AtkParam_Pc), other characters BehaviorParam (with AtkParam_Npc). The row ID is looked up from the event's behaviour judge ID: base × 100,000,000 + variation × 1,000 + judge ID (base 1 for players and 2 for NPC rows; a judge ID of 1000 or more supplies its own base digit). Players take the variation from the weapon's Behavior Variation ID (110000 Unarmed for fist actions); if that row is missing, the variation rounded down to a multiple of 100 is tried, then variation 0.

Fields.Name: Behavior Variation ID
Fields.Description: Bookkeeping copy of the variation part of the row ID (the weapon's or NPC's Behavior Variation ID). The game doesn't read it: only the row ID matters. Retail rows match their ID (ID = base × 100,000,000 + this × 1,000 + Behavior Judge ID).

Fields.Name: Behavior Judge ID
Fields.Description: Bookkeeping copy of the last three digits of the row ID: the behaviour judge ID entered in the animation's behaviour event. The game doesn't read it: only the row ID matters.

Fields.Name: Behavior Table Type (Old)
Fields.Description: Appears unused by the game. Retail: 1 on every BehaviorParam_PC row and 2 on every BehaviorParam row (one row has 3), a leftover tag for the player and NPC tables.

Fields.Name: Reference Type
Fields.Description: What Reference ID points to: 0 Attack (AtkParam_Pc for BehaviorParam_PC, AtkParam_Npc for BehaviorParam), 1 Bullet, 2 SpEffect. Attack and bullet behaviours also pass Category on to the attack.

Fields.Name: Reference ID
Fields.Description: The AtkParam, Bullet or SpEffectParam row this behaviour uses, picked by Reference Type. -1: none.

Fields.Name: Poise Cost
Fields.Description: Poise the character loses when the behaviour runs, taken from its current poise. 0: none. Retail: only some skeleton enemy attacks (20).

Fields.Name: Stamina Cost
Fields.Description: Stamina spent when the behaviour runs. Multiplied by the character's SpEffect stamina-cost rates, by the weapon's Stamina Consumption Rate for weapon attacks, and by the low-stat penalty rate when the player doesn't meet the weapon's requirements; the result is rounded down. For a guard behaviour it is also added as a flat amount to the stamina lost when blocking. Retail: 0 on NPC rows; most player attacks 8–30.

Fields.Name: Durability Cost
Fields.Description: Weapon durability spent when the behaviour runs. When this is not 0 and the player's weapon has no durability left, the behaviour doesn't run. Retail: 0 on every row.

Fields.Name: Category
Fields.Description: Which buffs and SpEffect attack-rate changes apply to this behaviour's attacks and bullets (the same kind as Goods and Magic SpEffect Category). 1 Right-Hand Weapon and 2 Left-Hand Weapon take buffs limited to that hand; 12 Active Weapon takes right-hand buffs, and left-hand buffs while the left weapon is two-handed; 9 Kick takes kick buffs; 3 Sorcery and 4 Incantation take sorcery or incantation buffs; 0, 5–8 take only unrestricted buffs. Retail: 1/2/12 player weapon attacks, 6/7 NPC attacks.

Fields.Name: Hero Point Cost
Fields.Description: A legacy cost (Humanity in earlier games): the behaviour doesn't run when the player has fewer hero points than this. Retail: 0 on every row; leave at 0.
